ns2:course.label: Seminar Philosophy of Mind
ns2:course.description: Selected topics from major writings in the philosophy of mind. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or separate terms. Approved for letter grading when offered for 4 hours; approved for S/U grading when offered for 2 hours - only available for Stage 3 Philosophy PhD students. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
